top10.descricao_en: 麦田：自媒体多平台发布中控与数据监控（B站/抖音/小红书/视频号/YouTube/X），飞书卡片通知 + 数据大屏
top10.readme:
一行装好  ·
   看它跑一遍  ·
   怎么配合  ·
   各平台的坑  ·
   作者 
一个人做内容，要发六七个平台，每个平台的文案、封面、发布形式都不一样；发完还想知道哪期起来了、哪个平台涨粉、哪个平台真的带来了付费。麦田就是我自己每天在用的那套工作台：
1. **发得出去**：一期视频分批填好 B站、抖音、小红书、视频号、YouTube、X、Instagram，提前排进「分发计划」，到点发布、自动取链接。
2. **看得清楚**：每期在每个平台的播放、互动，各平台粉丝，每天自动采、长期留存；手机上看大屏，飞书群推卡片。
3. **算得出钱**：接上你自己的站点，看哪一期、哪个平台带来了注册和收入。
> 跑在一台常开的 Mac 上，用你自己登录好的浏览器操作各平台，**不存任何平台密码**。国内四家只填写不发布，最后一下由你自己点。
## 看它跑一遍
  一期视频从写文案到上线（47 秒，各平台发布页为示意，数据是作者第 4 期的真实文案和封面）·  高清 MP4   
  大屏（演示数据， node src/demo.mjs  就能看到）  
| 日历：分发计划 | 单期复盘：同龄对比 | 每期转化漏斗 |
|---|---|---|
|   |   |   |
## 怎么配合
| 部分 | 做什么 | 在哪 |
|---|---|---|
| 发布 skill | 让 AI 助手（Claude Code / Codex）看片、写各平台文案、生成发布工程并校验 | 本仓库 [`skills/maitian-publish`](skills/maitian-publish/SKILL.md) |
| 麦田发布助手 | Chrome 插件，各平台适配器：打开上传页、传视频和封面、填文案、设定时 | [Chrome 应用商店](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/eaaipbilkhibicihiollecmbpneikpnj)（装进麦田的专用 Chrome，自动更新） |
| 麦田（本仓库） | 分发计划、调度、防重、等你点发布、取链接、采数据、网页大屏、飞书通知 | 本仓库 |
链路：成片 → skill 写「发布素材.md」→ 生成 `publish.json` → `hub plan` 进分发计划 → `hub run` 分批填写 → 国内平台你点发布 → 到点取链接 → 每天采数据 → 大屏和飞书卡片。
## 安装
三种方式，按自己习惯挑一种。
### Agent 自动安装
不动手也能装：把下面这段话复制给你的 AI 助手（Claude Code / Codex 等）。它会读专门的[安装指引](agent-install.md)，自行装好麦田本体，并把发布 skill 装进**它自己**的 skill 目录——各 Agent 的 skill 目录不同，所以让 Agent 按指引自行安装，不依赖一行安装脚本里写死的 Claude 路径：
```text
请帮我接入麦田的发布能力：阅读 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CzzzzzzJ/mdldm-maitian/main/agent-install.md 并严格按其中的步骤完成安装与授权。
```
### 一行装好
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CzzzzzzJ/mdldm-maitian/main/scripts/install.sh)"
```
下载麦田和发布助手到 `~/maitian/`、接上发布 skill、打开安装向导；向导问完几个问题，生成配置、装好开机自启、打开各平台登录页。需要 macOS、Node.js ≥ 22.5、Google Chrome。
Windows（社区贡献，感谢 [ajin558](https://github.com/ajin558)；开机自启暂未适配）：
```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CzzzzzzJ/mdldm-maitian/main/scripts/install-windows.ps1 | iex"
```
同样下载到 `%USERPROFILE%\maitian\`、接上发布 skill、打开安装向导，安装目录里另有 4 个双击启动器（演示 / 登录 / 体检 / 启动）。需要 Windows 10/11、Node.js ≥ 22.5、Google Chrome；缺 Git / Node 时脚本会用 winget 自动补装。开机自启暂未适配（向导里的 launchd 步骤会自动跳过），可用任务计划程序指向安装目录的 `4-start.bat` 代替。
### 手动安装
或者手动：
需要：macOS、Node.js ≥ 22.5（用到内置 `node:sqlite`）、Google Chrome；可选 NAS（放成片）、飞书群机器人、cloudflared。
```bash
git clone https://github.com/CzzzzzzJ/mdldm-maitian.git && cd mdldm-maitian
node src/demo.mjs                       # 先用假数据看看效果：http://localhost:8788/?key=demo
node src/init.mjs                       # 安装向导：检查环境、生成 config.json、装开机自启；在专用 Chrome 里从应用商店添加麦田发布助手、登录各平台
node src/hub.mjs doctor

# SoduWork
## The AI-native engine for teams and their agents
**A chat ends with an answer. A SoduWork request ends when the person who asked signs off.**
**Multi-harness · Multi-agent · Self-hosted**
Works with Pi · OpenCode · DeepSeek Harness · Qwen Code · Kimi Code · Codex Harness · Codex
```sh
git clone https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork
cd SoduWork
```
| Platform | Start command |
| --- | --- |
| macOS / Linux | `sh start.sh --desktop` |
| Windows PowerShell | `.\start.cmd --desktop` |
| Windows Command Prompt | `start.cmd --desktop` |
[Website](https://soduwork.ai) | [Live demo](https://soduwork.ai) | [Documentation](docs/README.md) | [Docs website](https://dev.soduwork.ai) | [Releases](https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork/releases) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/AXYNrAYHy)
[ ](LICENSE)
[ ](https://github.com/mdiri-ai/SoduWork/releases)
[ ](#quick-start)
[ ](https://discord.gg/AXYNrAYHy)
---
## What SoduWork can do for you
| | |
| --- | --- |
| **One harness does the work, another reviews it** | Pick Pi to do the work. OpenCode, on a different model, reviews it against the acceptance criteria. If the review fails, the work goes back with the reasons. |
| **Hand a request to a colleague's agent** | People and AI work together: you file a request, AI writes the acceptance criteria, and you assign it to yourself or a colleague. The assignee's agent does the work and reviews it, and a person signs off. Everyone on the request can see who did what. |
| **Turn one person's know-how into a team asset** | When you and AI get a task right, save the chat as a plugin. After review, anyone on the team can use it and contribute improvements, with access granted as needed. |
## Core ideas
**🔀 Smart dispatch**
**The right agent and model for each job.**
- Pick a harness for each step and switch mid-conversation
- Routine steps on cheap or local models, strong models where it matters
- Long tasks go to your own cloud runner
**🛡️ Built-in governance**
**Your organization decides which AI does what, and where.**
- Plugins are reviewed before they are shared, granted to teams or people, and can be revoked
- Roles, usage, cost and an audit log
- Self-hosted
**✅ Verified delivery**
**Set the bar first. Done means the requester signed off.**
- Every request carries its acceptance criteria
- A separate AI review checks each one

## About
Concat is a free, open-source video editor for macOS, Windows, Linux, Android and iOS. It covers what most edits need: auto-captions, voice isolation, text-to-speech, background removal, animations and keyframes, effects and titles, multi-track cutting, 4K export. With none of the catches: no watermark, no account, no subscription, no upload.
Everything runs on your machine. Install it, drop in footage, cut. The AI models for captions, voices and cutout download once from Settings and work offline after that. Your footage never leaves your disk.
**Good for:** TikTok, Reels and Shorts, YouTube videos, tutorials and screen recordings, podcast clips, memes.
**Also for machines:** a built-in MCP server for AI agents (`concat --mcp`, [set up](docs/MCP.md)) and a JSON-RPC API for scripts, so they can cut video with it too.

top10.descricao_en: Poki uses your iPhone like you do. An open-source agent app that runs on your iPhone, reads the screen, and taps, types and swipes in real apps with your own model account.
top10.readme:
Copy this prompt and send it to your coding agent 
```text
Install Poki on my iPhone from https://github.com/JosssphZhou/poki
```
  Connect your iPhone over USB and unlock it first. A free Apple Account works.  
  English |  简体中文  |  繁體中文  |  日本語  |  한국어  |  Español  
   poki.bot 
   If Poki is useful to you, click ★ Star to support the project. 
## What Poki is
Poki is an open-source iPhone agent that operates your entire iPhone for you. The Poki app runs directly on your iPhone, reads the screen, and taps, types, and scrolls inside real apps using your own model account. You choose how it asks for permission; payments, deletions, and Wallet actions always stop for your confirmation.
## Why Poki
- **Skip multi-app tapping for everyday errands.** Ask Poki in chat, hold the Action Button, or trigger Siri to look things up in the built-in browser, check tomorrow's weather, or create a note. On iPhone Duo, Poki works across two apps side by side in Split View.
- **Run saved skills by tap or by voice.** Launch a saved skill from the home screen instead of repeating the same steps every day, or start a hands-free spoken chat with Talk to Poki while Dynamic Island tracks each step.
- **Automate your real phone without keeping a computer on.** Once installed from a Mac or Windows PC, Poki runs standalone on your iPhone with no computer attached and pauses on the Lock Screen or in Dynamic Island whenever a step needs approval.
## How to use
### Install Poki on your iPhone
1. **Install once from a Mac or Windows PC.** Connect and unlock your iPhone over USB (a free Apple Account works), then tell your coding agent, such as Claude Code or Codex:
   ```text
   Install Poki on my iPhone from https://github.com/JosssphZhou/poki
   ```
   Or download [Poki Setup](https://github.com/JosssphZhou/poki/releases/tag/desktop-v0.2.8) for macOS (`.dmg`) or Windows (`.exe`) and follow the window.
2. **Connect and add your model account.** Accept **Trust**, turn on Developer Mode and Automation Mode when iOS asks, set up an external connection routing `10.7.0.1` back to your iPhone (such as free LocalDevVPN), and sign in with ChatGPT Plus or Pro or paste an API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, OpenCode Go, or an OpenAI-compatible server).
3. **Run your first task.** Open Poki and send:
   ```text
   Create a new note in Notes titled "Poki Demo" with these three lines: Milk, Eggs, Coffee. Open the note when finished. Leave existing notes unchanged.
   ```
